title: Amy J NDE 234
content: I lost consciousness in the hospital emergency room, stopped breathing. Suddenly I became aware of being in a space filled with bright golden yellow light, with the feeling you get if you walk into a party where no one expected you and everyone stops and turns to look at you, as if to say, 'What are you doing here?' I couldn't see anything because the light was so bright but could sense others around me moving forward in one direction. I was not moving and felt like I had just stuck my head and shoulders up through a hole in the floor to see what was going on. At first I fought it (don't ask me what 'it' was, I think I was just being stubborn), but I remember thinking 'Hey, this isn't so bad!' I felt very warm (the inside kind and physically) and peaceful and safe. I felt like everything before just kind of came together to put me at this place where I was supposed to be. Just as I was starting to accept all this, it was as if I was sucked up by a vacuum and it was gone, I was in darkness with no sense of having a real body but could hear my sister's voice. I later found out that she was in the building but not in the same room with me at this time. I felt angry and afraid of where I was. 'How dare they! What fools to pull me back!?!' It took a couple days but I got over being mad. I now know that death is a good thing and not something to be feared. I'll wait until the party is ready for me and know that it is all for a reason that I don't question or concern myself with. I am not going to proof read this so please excuse my spelling, etc. I wrote it just as if I was speaking to you. Bye

arrival.other_being_detail: Could not see beings due to brightness; sensed others around moving forward in one direction.

environment.environment_other_detail: Space filled with bright golden yellow light; experiencer could not see anything because it was so bright.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'sucked up by a vacuum' and the light was gone; then in darkness and could hear sister's voice.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard sister's voice while in darkness; sensed others around in the light; felt like sticking head/shoulders through a hole in the floor.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Light-filled space first, then abrupt transition to darkness and auditory perception of sister's voice, followed by return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Felt like arriving unexpectedly at a party where everyone turned to look; felt like head/shoulders up through a hole in the floor; abrupt 'vacuum' pull into darkness with sister's voice heard though she was elsewhere in the building.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “What are you doing here?”; “Hey, this isn't so bad!”; “How dare they! What fools to pull me back!?!”
